seeds.headline: The Crowded Exit: Why Record Corporate Bond Issuance Is a Red Flag for Bitcoin
seeds.angle: Corporate debt markets hitting records despite rising rates = refinancing panic, not strength. Bitcoin's accumulation phase in $65K-$75K range reflects smart money hedging against credit system breakdown.

seeds.headline: Miner Confidence at 888 EH/s: What Hashrate Expansion Reveals During Extreme Fear
seeds.angle: While Fear & Greed bottoms at 11, hashrate climbs—miners are skin-in-the-game players voting with infrastructure. Historical playbook: extreme fear + rising hashrate = volatility precursor.

seeds.headline: When Credit Dominoes Fall: Bitcoin as Trustless Exit
seeds.angle: Private credit seizure breaks refinancing chains first, then cascades. Bitcoin's proof-of-work asymmetry—costless verification, impossible tampering—emerges as the only system immune to contagion.
